query:
UPDATE work.access_realm
             SET state = 'refused',
                 refusal_code = $3,
                 instance = NULL,
                 paired_at = NULL,
                 updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at,
                     pg_catalog.to_timestamp(0) + interval '1 millisecond' * $4::bigint::double precision)
             WHERE tenant = $1 AND realm = $2::text::uuid
